retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle male portrait featuring high-contrast golden hour lighting against a flat, saturated teal sky with heavy film grain.
triggerTerms: harsh warm sunlight on face blue background
excludeWhen: black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in a denim jacket, captured from a low angle. The subject is illuminated by intense, warm directional sunlight from the side, creating deep shadows and bright highlights. The background is a solid, grain-textured teal-blue sky. The overall image has a vintage film aesthetic with visible noise and a distinct teal-and-orange color grade.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between the warm skin tones and the cool teal background
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subject's stature
Heavy film grain texture unifying the subject and the background
Harsh side-lighting creating a dramatic chiaroscuro effect on the face
coreInvariants: Denim texture with visible stitching and metal buttons
Warm, orange-tinted highlights on the subject
Heavy digital or film grain overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, viewed from a low angle looking up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the high-contrast line between light and shadow on the nose and cheek.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face, moves down the vertical line of the jacket buttons, and then takes in the expansive teal space above.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third of the frame, consisting of a flat, textured blue field.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden-orange highlights on skin and jacket edges
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/metallic glints from jacket buttons and chain
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background; high value contrast on the subject's face.

letterConstructionRules: Low opacity integration into the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters merged into a singular iconographic emblem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Minimalist icon paired with high-texture photography

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thin, symbolic nature of the existing graphic.
Maintains the clean, modern aesthetic if text is needed.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle portrait of a man with short dark hair wearing a dark denim jacket over a black shirt. Apply harsh, warm golden-hour sunlight from the left side. The background must be a solid, saturated teal-blue sky. Apply a heavy film grain texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a thin, white, semi-transparent geometric emblem or sigil in the top right corner. The emblem should look like a watermark, integrated into the grain of the sky.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional and warm?
Is the background a solid teal color?
Is the perspective from a low angle?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the golden hour glow
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Unique brand logos or specific sigil designs

mustAchieve: High-contrast teal and orange color grade

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain is consistent across both subject and sky
Check that the low-angle perspective is maintained
Verify the complementary color contrast is prominent
Confirm the logo/emblem is subtle and semi-transparent
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle portrait + Denim texture + Golden hour side-lighting + Solid teal sky + Heavy film grain = Indie Film Aesthetic.
